//: Senses (15 §4) an ordinary person has. A full-grown person standing in daylight is seen at once out to about 50 m and, in deep shadow, not beyond a step or two.
doc: Sight: sixty metres, two hundred degrees about the facing.

//: Touch: feeling what lands on one's own body. It reaches no further than half a metre, one's own place, so a blow is felt only by whoever it lands on; and since nothing gives off touch standing still it finds nothing by sweeping, and sweeps once an hour.
doc: Touch: what lands on one's own body is felt.
